scripts.schematic: tsci check netlist index.circuit.tsx && tsci build index.circuit.tsx --routing-disabled --schematic-png --ignore-errors
scripts.placement: tsci check placement index.circuit.tsx; tsci build index.circuit.tsx --routing-disabled --pcb-png --ignore-errors
scripts.fab: tsci build index.circuit.tsx && bun scripts/silk.ts && bun scripts/paste.ts && rm -rf fab/blade-reader fab/blade-reader.zip && mkdir -p fab && tsci export dist/index/circuit.json -f gerbers -o "$PWD/fab/blade-reader.zip" && zip -q -d fab/blade-reader.zip F_Fab.gbr && unzip -q fab/blade-reader.zip -d fab/blade-reader && bun scripts/silk.ts dist/index/circuit.json fab/blade-reader && bun scripts/paste.ts dist/index/circuit.json fab/blade-reader
scripts.step: tsci build index.circuit.tsx --routing-disabled --ignore-errors && mkdir -p fab && tsci export dist/index/circuit.json -f step -o "$PWD/fab/blade-reader.step"
scripts.fit-print: tsci build index.circuit.tsx --routing-disabled --ignore-errors && bun scripts/fit-print.ts && bun scripts/fit-plate.ts
